newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks steady to higher in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks steady to higher in slow trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly steady to higher in a slow trade on Wednesday with mild gains in blue chips.
* Six of 11 active stocks rose, three fell and two were flat.
* Volume fell to 12,018 units and turnover to five million kuna.
* Leading gainer was Zagrebacka Banka's E-series preference stock, up 5.26 percent to 1,000 kuna on volume of 583 units.
* Bigger of the two losers was hotelier Riviera, dipping 23 kuna or 13.93 percent to 142 kuna on volume of 134.
* Food concern Podravka was the most actively traded issue with 8,977 shares sold. It closed seven kuna lower at 368.
